integrity: Mathematical support and limiting argument presented in complete standalone result; finite support checks executable. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only homogeneous wheel rim roots and common positive spoke weight; no assertion for arbitrary weighted graphs. Critical-window finite-size convergence is slow. Equivalence in other Gaussian extremal terminology remains a bibliographic risk. Finite checks do not certify asymptotics.
title: Rim–spoke Gaussian exposure crossover in weighted wheel symmetric edge polytopes
